titulo: Nepal-Tibet floods live: At least 750 dead as rising water levels hamper rescue efforts
cuerpo: At least 750 people have died and more than 3,000 remain missing after devastating floods struck Nepal and Tibet near the Chinese border, local authorities said Sunday. Rescue efforts are entering a fifth day, with heavy overnight rain and rising river waters hampering operations to reach hydropower workers believed to be trapped in tunnels. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
